skills.name: agent-mail
skills.description: Use when you must read, triage, draft, reply to, or send mail from the agent-owned mailbox, or when a delegated email task needs the Email permissions rules.

skills.name: browser-management
skills.description: Use when you acquire, extend, release, or contend for a rented cloud browser lease, or when guidance tokens and shared write leases decide who may drive.

skills.name: browser-use
skills.description: Use when you drive a rented cloud browser to read a page, fill a form, or complete a flow, and you need the snapshot, ref, and verification discipline that keeps the run truthful.

skills.name: bug-report
skills.description: Use when Dora itself misbehaves, such as a tool returning a wrong result, a wake misfiring, or a page breaking because of our side, and the member needs it reported with the right evidence.

skills.name: company-identity
skills.description: Use when the member asks about Dora the company, its founders or creators, or who built this agent, while product, feature, integration, and launch questions belong to dora-faq.

skills.name: data-privacy
skills.description: Use when the member asks what data Dora stores, how it is used, whether it trains models, or how to delete it.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description: Use when a question needs multiple sources, conflicting evidence must be weighed, or the answer will feed a decision with money, legal, or health stakes.

skills.name: document-signing
skills.description: Use when a document must be prepared, filled, or signed, or when the member asks whether something can be signed on their behalf.

skills.name: dora-faq
skills.description: Use when the member asks what Dora can do, which integrations exist, whether something has launched or is available, or how pricing works.

skills.name: messaging
skills.description: Use when you write to another person as the member over WhatsApp, iMessage/SMS, or any other authenticated conversation channel.

skills.name: onboarding
skills.description: Use during the member's first run, when you need to learn who they are, connect their services, and set up the first outcomes.

skills.name: presentations
skills.description: Use when the member asks for a slide deck, a pitch, or a readout built from their own material.

skills.name: proactive-value-creation
skills.description: Use when you are running as a platform-owned recurring task agent whose job is to create value the user should not have to ask for.

skills.name: scheduling
skills.description: Use when the member asks to schedule, move, or protect time on their calendar, or when a conflict, buffer, or travel time decides the answer.

skills.name: shopping
skills.description: Use when the member asks you to research, compare, or buy a physical or digital product.

skills.name: food-ordering
skills.description: Use when the member asks you to order food for delivery or pickup.

skills.name: restaurant-booking
skills.description: Use when the member asks you to book, hold, change, or cancel a table.

skills.name: restaurant-recommendations
skills.description: Use when the member asks where to eat and no specific restaurant has been chosen yet.

skills.name: rideshare
skills.description: Use when the member asks you to book a ride or decide when to leave for one.

skills.name: flight-booking
skills.description: Use when the member asks you to search, compare, or book flights.

skills.name: google-docs
skills.description: Use when you read, edit, or comment on a Google Doc, especially one the member shares with other people.

skills.name: speaking
skills.description: Use when you speak to the member aloud or read text into a voice channel.

skills.name: wake-subscriptions
skills.description: Use when you decide how to watch a future signal, choosing an event subscription or a scheduled wake, and when to cancel what you created.

skills.name: gamepigeon
skills.description: Use when you play a turn-based GamePigeon game with the member over iMessage.
